contracts.name: auctionhouse
contracts.description: Auctions with reserve prices, buy-now support, and timed settlement.

options.name: account
options.description:
Account that holds bids in custody, refunds outbid bidders and pays
sellers. Bids must be sent to it. Defaults to the streamer username.

actions.name: placeBid
actions.description: Bid by sending the full bid amount to the auction account. Outbid bidders are refunded automatically; bids that cannot be accepted are sent back.

actions.name: settleAuction
actions.description: Close an ended auction: pays the seller when the reserve is met, otherwise refunds the highest bidder. Calling it again retries any payout whose transfer failed.

contracts.name: badges
contracts.description: Non-transferable achievements and badges issued by authorised issuers or earned by payment and check-in rules.

options.name: account
options.description: Account that receives `payment_total` rule payments. Required to use payment rules.

options.name: admins
options.description: When set, only these accounts can define badges.

actions.name: defineBadge
actions.description: Define a non-transferable badge with issuers, optional supply cap and an optional earning rule.

actions.name: issueBadge
actions.description: Issuer-only: award a badge to an account.

actions.name: revokeBadge
actions.description: Issuer-only: revoke a badge with a public reason.

actions.name: updateIssuers
actions.description: Creator-only: add or remove issuers (the creator always remains an issuer).

actions.name: contribute
actions.description: Count a payment toward a payment_total badge; the badge is awarded when the threshold is reached.

actions.name: checkIn
actions.description: Record a periodic check-in toward a checkin_count badge (optionally requiring consecutive periods).

contracts.name: bookings
contracts.description: Reservable listings with paid booking windows and confirmations.

options.name: account
options.description:
Account that receives reservation payments and refunds rejected ones
(wrong amount or asset, overlaps, inactive listings). Refunds are
signed with the app's active key, so this must be the app account.
Defaults to the streamer username.

actions.name: reserve
actions.description: Reserve a slot by paying the exact listing price; wrong amounts or assets, overlaps and inactive listings are refunded.

actions.name: confirmReservation
actions.description: Listing owner confirms a pending reservation.

actions.name: cancelReservation
actions.description: Owner or booker (within the cancellation window) cancels a pending or confirmed reservation.

actions.name: completeReservation
actions.description: Mark a pending or confirmed reservation completed (owner or scheduled).

contracts.name: bountyboard
contracts.description: Funded bounties, submissions, and award selection.

options.name: account
options.description:
Account that receives bounty rewards and refunds rejected ones.
Refunds are signed with the app's active key, so this must be the app
account. Defaults to the streamer username.

actions.name: createBounty
actions.description: Fund a new bounty by sending the reward to the app account; a duplicate bounty id or an invalid or past deadline is refunded.

actions.name: closeBounty
actions.description: Close an open bounty (sponsor or scheduled). Emits bounty_closed with the unawarded remainder once and zeroes it.

contracts.name: bridge
contracts.description: A custody bridge/peg with M-of-N operator attestations, fees, per-transaction and daily limits, a pause switch and a full audit trail.

options.name: custodyAccount
options.description: Hive account that holds bridged funds. Deposits must be sent here.

options.name: operators
options.description: Accounts allowed to attest deposits and withdrawals.

options.name: threshold
options.description: Attestations required to act (M of N). Defaults to a strict majority.

options.name: assets
options.description: Hive assets the bridge accepts. Defaults to HIVE and HBD.

options.name: chains
options.description: Allowed external chain identifiers. When omitted any well-formed id is accepted.

options.name: addressPattern
options.description: Validates destination addresses, globally or per chain.

options.name: feeBps
options.description: Fee charged on both directions, in basis points (max 2000).

options.name: maxPerTx
options.description: Largest single deposit or withdrawal. Larger withdrawals are rejected when requested or attested.

options.name: dailyLimit
options.description: Rolling 24h cap per asset and direction across all users.

options.name: accountDailyLimit
options.description: Rolling 24h cap on deposits per Hive account and asset.

options.name: admins
options.description: Accounts allowed to pause/unpause and retry failed releases and refunds. Defaults to the custody account.

options.name: receipts
options.description:
Publish the contract's decision on each deposit on-chain. When enabled,
the custody account broadcasts a custom_json (posting authority) as soon
as a deposit is accepted or refunded, so operators can act on the
contract's verdict instead of re-implementing its checks. Accepted
receipts include the rolling 24h totals used for the daily limits.
`true` uses the custom_json id `<contract name>-receipts`. Off by default.

actions.name: deposit
actions.description: Deposit HIVE/HBD to the custody account with the destination chain and address; invalid deposits are refunded automatically.

actions.name: attestDeposit
actions.description: Operator attestation that a deposit was minted on the destination chain (or should be refunded). Acts at the M-of-N threshold.

actions.name: requestWithdrawal
actions.description: Register a withdrawal back to Hive for funds locked or burned on another chain. Until an operator attests it, the request is only a claim: the first operator attestation replaces a mismatched recipient, amount or asset.

actions.name: attestWithdrawal
actions.description: Operator attestation that a withdrawal is valid (release) or invalid (reject). Releases at the M-of-N threshold within limits.

actions.name: executeWithdrawal
actions.description: Retry a queued withdrawal, or (admins only) a failed release after manual reconciliation.

actions.name: retryRefund
actions.description: Admin-only: re-send a deposit refund whose broadcast failed, after reconciling it.

actions.name: processQueue
actions.description: Scheduled release of withdrawals queued by a pause or the daily limit.

actions.name: setPaused
actions.description: Pause or resume the bridge (admins only). Paused deposits are refunded and releases are queued.

contracts.name: bundlemarketplace
contracts.description: Fixed-price bundle storefronts with inventory tracking.

contracts.name: charitymatch
contracts.description: Donation campaigns with matched totals and closing summaries.

contracts.name: checkpoint
contracts.description: Deterministic state hashes published on-chain for operator verification.

contracts.name: coinflip
contracts.description: A heads-or-tails coin flip game.

options.name: account
options.description: House account that receives bets and pays winners. Defaults to the streamer username.

options.name: tokenSymbol
options.description: Default accepted asset (HIVE). Winnings are always paid in the asset that was bet.

options.name: validCurrencies
options.description: Accepted assets (HIVE and/or HBD). Defaults to `[tokenSymbol]`.

options.name: houseEdge
options.description: House edge in percent (default 2). A win pays the stake x 2 x (100 - houseEdge) / 100, rounded down.

options.name: notifyLosses
options.description: Send a 0.001 notice transfer on losses (default false; results are always recorded as events).

options.name: fairness
options.description:
Provably-fair commit-reveal draws, on by default. Pass options or a
shared FairnessManager to customise, or `false` for the legacy RNG
(block ids plus an uncommitted server seed; not verifiable).

actions.name: flip
actions.description: Bet on a provably-fair coin flip by transferring to the house account. `guess` must be "heads" or "tails" and `seed` (optional client seed) at most 64 characters; anything else is refunded. Winners receive 2x the stake less the house edge (2% by default).

actions.name: rotateSeed
actions.description: Reveal the current server seed and commit to a new one (house account only).

contracts.name: crowdfund
contracts.description: Crowdfunding campaigns with milestones, finalization, and refunds.

options.name: account
options.description:
Account that receives contributions and pays milestone releases and
refunds. Payouts are signed with the app's active key, so this must be
the app account. Defaults to the streamer username.

actions.name: contribute
actions.description: Contribute by sending the campaign asset to the app account; contributions to a missing, closed or expired campaign, or in the wrong asset, are refunded.

actions.name: releaseMilestone
actions.description: Creator releases a milestone's share of a funded campaign to the beneficiary from the app account; a failed broadcast can be retried by calling it again.

actions.name: refundContribution
actions.description: Refund your contributions to a failed campaign from the app account; a failed broadcast can be retried by calling it again.

contracts.name: dao
contracts.description: A DAO treasury with stake-weighted voting (Hive Power, Hive Engine stake or one per account), quorum, proposal deposits, an admin veto timelock and retryable payouts.

options.name: account
options.description:
Treasury account: receives deposits and proposal deposits and sends
payouts. Defaults to the streamer username.

options.name: votingPower
options.description:
How votes are weighted, snapshotted when the vote is cast:
'hive-power' (the voter's own Hive Power; delegations in or out are
ignored), 'engine-token' (the voter's staked `tokenSymbol`) or 'equal'
(one per account). Defaults to 'hive-power'.

options.name: tokenSymbol
options.description: Hive Engine token whose stake weights votes. Required for 'engine-token'.

options.name: proposalDeposit
options.description:
Deposit a proposer sends with createProposal, in `depositAsset`.
Refunded when the proposal reaches quorum and kept by the treasury
otherwise (spam protection). Defaults to '1.000'.

options.name: depositAsset
options.description: Asset of the proposal deposit. Defaults to 'HIVE'.

options.name: votingPeriodHours
options.description: How long a proposal is open for voting. Defaults to 72.

options.name: timelockHours
options.description: Delay between a proposal passing and its payouts, during which admins can veto. Defaults to 24.

options.name: quorum
options.description:
Absolute quorum: the voting weight (for + against) a proposal needs,
in HP for 'hive-power', tokens for 'engine-token' and voters for
'equal'. Total Hive Power can't be summed per app, so quorum is an
amount, not a share of supply. Defaults to '1000'.

options.name: passThresholdBps
admins
options.description: Accounts that can veto during the timelock and change parameters. Defaults to the treasury account.

options.name: allowedAssets
options.description: Assets the treasury accepts and pays out. Defaults to ['HIVE', 'HBD'].

actions.name: deposit
actions.description: Fund the treasury with a transfer to the treasury account. Assets the treasury does not accept are refunded.

actions.name: createProposal
actions.description: Open a proposal by sending the proposal deposit. Wrong deposits, invalid payloads and payouts above the available treasury balance are refunded.

example.title: Fund the community meetup
example.description: Venue and catering for the October meetup.

actions.name: vote
actions.description: Vote for or against an open proposal. Weight is snapshotted when the vote is cast; a later vote by the same account replaces it.

actions.name: tally
actions.description: Close proposals whose voting period has ended (anyone, or a scheduled time action): mark them passed or failed, refund or keep deposits and start the timelock.

actions.name: execute
actions.description: Pay out passed proposals whose timelock has elapsed (anyone, or a scheduled time action). Call it with a proposalId to retry failed payouts.

actions.name: vetoProposal
actions.description: Admin-only: veto a passed proposal during its timelock.

actions.name: cancelProposal
actions.description: Proposer-only: withdraw a proposal before anyone votes. The deposit stays with the treasury.

actions.name: setParams
actions.description: Admin-only: change quorum, pass threshold, voting period, timelock or proposal deposit for new proposals.

contracts.name: dcabots
contracts.description: Time-based DCA bot scheduling and execution request events.

contracts.name: domains
contracts.description: App-level namespaces with registrations, renewals, and transfers.

contracts.name: escrowmarket
contracts.description: A peer-to-peer marketplace settled through Hive native escrow, with the app account as escrow agent: listings, auto-ratified trades, shipping and delivery tracking, and agent dispute resolution.

options.name: account
options.description: Escrow agent account. Buyers must name it as `agent`. Defaults to the streamer username.

options.name: agentFeeBps
options.description: Agent fee the buyer must include in the escrow, in basis points of the price (default 100 = 1%).

options.name: ratificationHours
options.description: Longest allowed gap between the escrow and its ratification deadline, in hours (default 24).

options.name: expirationDays
options.description: Minimum escrow lifetime (block time to expiration), in days (default 30).

options.name: autoApprove
options.description: Approve valid escrows as the agent automatically (default true).

options.name: allowedAssets
options.description: Assets listings may be priced in. Defaults to HIVE and HBD.

actions.name: createListing
actions.description: List an item for sale at a fixed price in HIVE or HBD. The sender is the seller.

actions.name: cancelListing
actions.description: Withdraw a listing (seller only, while no trade is open on it).

actions.name: openTrade
actions.description: Buy a listing: send escrow_transfer to the seller with this contract's account as agent, at least the price and the agent fee, and this call in json_meta. Invalid escrows are recorded as rejected and never ratified, so the chain returns the funds at the ratification deadline.

actions.name: approveTrade
actions.description: Agent only: ratify a pending escrow as the agent (when autoApprove is off, or to retry a failed approval).

actions.name: markShipped
actions.description: Seller marks a ratified trade as shipped.

actions.name: confirmDelivery
actions.description: Buyer records delivery. Funds move only when the buyer also broadcasts escrow_release to the seller; the contract closes the trade when it sees that release on chain.

actions.name: resolveDispute
actions.description: Agent only: release a disputed escrow to the buyer or seller (the full balance unless amounts are given).

actions.name: expireTrades
actions.description: Scheduled sweep: marks unratified escrows past their deadline, and ratified escrows past expiration, as expired.

contracts.name: exchange
contracts.description: An order-book exchange with deposits, withdrawals, balances, and matching.

contracts.name: fanclub
contracts.description: Paid fan clubs with renewals, engagement points, and perk redemptions.

contracts.name: giftcards
contracts.description: Gift card issuance, redemption, and cancellation.

contracts.name: grantrounds
contracts.description: Matching grant rounds with submissions, donations, and allocations.

contracts.name: groupbuy
contracts.description: Threshold-based pooled purchases.

options.name: account
options.description:
Account that receives commitments and refunds rejected ones. Refunds
are signed with the app's active key, so this must be the app
account. Defaults to the streamer username.

actions.name: commit
actions.description: Commit funds by sending the group buy asset to the app account; commitments to a missing, closed or expired group buy, or in the wrong asset, are refunded.

actions.name: withdrawCommitment
actions.description: Withdraw your commitments before the deadline (lowering the totals) or after the group buy failed.

contracts.name: hivedice
contracts.description: A dice rolling game with configurable win chance and payout multipliers.

options.name: account
options.description: House account that receives bets and pays winners. Defaults to the streamer username.

options.name: tokenSymbol
options.description: Default accepted asset (HIVE). Winnings are always paid in the asset that was bet.

options.name: validCurrencies
options.description: Accepted assets (HIVE and/or HBD). Defaults to `[tokenSymbol]`.

options.name: houseEdge
options.description: House edge in percent (default 1). A win pays the fair odds x (100 - houseEdge) / 100, rounded down.

options.name: notifyLosses
options.description: Send a 0.001 notice transfer on losses (default false; results are always recorded as events).

options.name: fairness
options.description:
Provably-fair commit-reveal draws, on by default. Pass options or a
shared FairnessManager to customise, or `false` for the legacy block-id
RNG (not verifiable, and a block producer can bias it).

actions.name: roll
actions.description: Bet by transferring to the house account; you win when the provably-fair 1-100 roll is below your guess. `roll` must be a whole number from 2 to 96 (the win chance is roll - 1 percent) and `seed` (optional client seed) at most 64 characters; anything else is refunded.

actions.name: rotateSeed
actions.description: Reveal the current server seed and commit to a new one (house account only).

contracts.name: hivelotto
contracts.description: A lottery-style game with scheduled draws.

options.name: account
options.description: House account that sells tickets and pays winners. Defaults to the streamer username.

options.name: feeAccount
options.description: Receives the fee share of each pot. Defaults to the house account.

options.name: tokenSymbol
options.description: Asset tickets are priced and paid out in (HIVE or HBD). Tickets paid in any other asset are refunded.

options.name: validCurrencies
options.description: Accepted ticket assets. Defaults to `[tokenSymbol]`; a ticket must also be paid in `tokenSymbol`.

options.name: notifyLosses
options.description: Send a 0.001 notice transfer to entrants who did not win a draw (default false; results are always recorded on the draw).

options.name: fairness
options.description:
Provably-fair winner selection, on by default. The client seed is the
sha256 of every entry's transaction id, so all entrants contribute
entropy. Pass `false` for the legacy block-id RNG (not verifiable).

actions.name: buy
actions.description: Buy a ticket for the hourly or daily draw by transferring the ticket cost in the lotto's asset. `type` must be "hourly" or "daily" (or another configured draw type); invalid tickets are refunded and overpayments are refunded down to the ticket cost.

actions.name: rotateSeed
actions.description: Reveal the current server seed and commit to a new one (house account only).

contracts.name: hivenft
contracts.description: NFT minting, transfers, market listings, and direct peer-to-peer sales.

options.name: account
options.description:
Marketplace account that receives `buyNFT` payments and pays sellers and
royalties. Defaults to the streamer's configured username.

contracts.name: hivetoken
contracts.description: App-level token issuance, transfers, and balances.

contracts.name: insurancepool
contracts.description: Insurance pools with premium-backed policies, claims, and reserves.

options.name: account
options.description:
Account that receives premiums and reserve funding and pays approved
claims. Payouts are signed with the app's active key, so this must be
the app account. Defaults to the streamer username.

actions.name: approveClaim
actions.description: Pool owner approves a pending claim (up to the requested amount and the coverage cap) and pays it from the app account.

actions.name: retryClaimPayout
actions.description: Re-send a claim payout whose broadcast failed (pool owner, claimant or app account).

contracts.name: invoices
contracts.description: Invoices with partial payments, recurring payments, and overdue sweeps.

contracts.name: launchpad
contracts.description: Launchpad sales with allocations, finalization, and claim flows.

options.name: account
options.description:
Account that receives contributions and sends refunds (unfilled
portions, and every contribution when a sale misses its soft cap).
Contributions must be sent to it. Defaults to the streamer username.

actions.name: createSale
actions.description: Open a token sale. Optional softCap is the minimum units that must sell; below it the sale fails and contributions are refunded.

actions.name: contribute
actions.description: Buy sale units by sending payment to the launchpad account. Whole units are filled up to what remains; any unfilled portion is refunded.

actions.name: finalizeSale
actions.description: Finalize a closed or sold-out sale. A sale below its soft cap fails and every contribution is refunded; calling it again retries failed refunds.

contracts.name: limbo
contracts.description: A provably-fair limbo/crash game: pick a target multiplier and win when the committed-seed result reaches it, with bankroll-based payout caps.

options.name: account
options.description: House account that receives bets and pays winners. Defaults to the streamer username.

options.name: assets
options.description: Accepted assets. Defaults to HIVE.

options.name: houseEdgeBps
options.description: House edge in basis points (default 100 = 1%).

options.name: minTarget
options.description: Lowest and highest target multipliers a player may choose.

options.name: maxPayout
options.description: Absolute cap on any single payout, in the bet's asset.

options.name: maxPayoutBankrollBps
options.description: Cap any single payout at this share of the available bankroll (basis points, default 100 = 1%).

options.name: notifyLosses
options.description: Send a 0.001 notice transfer on losses (default false; results are always recorded as events).

options.name: fairness
options.description: Fairness configuration. Always enabled for this game; defaults to block-entropy commit-reveal.

actions.name: bet
actions.description: Bet with a target multiplier (e.g. "2.5"); you win bet x target when the provably-fair result reaches it.

actions.name: rotateSeed
actions.description: Reveal the current server seed and commit to a new one (house account only).

contracts.name: multisigtreasury
contracts.description: Multisig vaults, proposal approvals, and execution readiness.

contracts.name: oraclebounty
contracts.description: Oracle bounty feeds with report rounds and median finalization.

actions.name: finalizeRound
actions.description: Compute the round median and credit in-tolerance reporters from the feed budget. Each round finalizes once.

contracts.name: p2pswap
contracts.description: A peer-to-peer swap desk for HIVE, HBD and Hive Engine tokens: HIVE/HBD swaps settle through Hive escrow with the app as agent, token swaps through the app account with retryable payouts.

options.name: account
options.description:
The app account: escrow agent for HIVE/HBD swaps and the account that
holds both legs of a swap involving a Hive Engine token. Defaults to the
streamer username.

options.name: feeBps
options.description:
Fee in basis points (max 2000, default 0). Custodial swaps deduct it
from the maker's proceeds; escrow swaps require the taker's escrow to
carry at least this agent fee in the buy-side asset.

options.name: allowedAssets
options.description: HIVE/HBD assets offers may sell or buy. Defaults to ['HIVE', 'HBD'].

options.name: allowedTokens
options.description: Hive Engine symbols offers may sell or buy. Defaults to [] (any symbol).

options.name: offerTtlHours
options.description: Default and maximum offer lifetime in hours. Defaults to 72.

actions.name: createOffer
actions.description: Post an all-or-nothing offer to swap sell for buy. HIVE<->HBD offers settle through Hive escrow; offers with a Hive Engine token settle through the app account.

actions.name: fundOffer
actions.description: Maker deposits the sell side of a custodial offer (a HIVE/HBD transfer here, or a Hive Engine transfer with the same memo). Mismatched deposits are refunded.

actions.name: takeOffer
actions.description: Take an offer. Escrow offers: an escrow_transfer of the buy side to the maker with the app as agent. Custodial offers: pay the buy side to the app (transfer or Hive Engine transfer). Mismatched payments are refunded or the escrow rejected.

actions.name: settle
actions.description: Maker pays the sell side of a taken escrow offer straight to the taker; the app then approves the taker's escrow as agent.

actions.name: cancelOffer
actions.description: Maker cancels an untaken offer; a funded custodial offer is refunded.

actions.name: expireOffers
actions.description: Scheduled: expire untaken offers (refunding deposits) and return escrows whose maker did not pay in time.

actions.name: retryPayouts
actions.description: App account only: re-broadcast failed payouts, refunds and escrow approvals (all, or one payoutId) after checking the account history.

contracts.name: payroll
contracts.description: Recurring team payrolls with funded budgets and scheduled runs.

contracts.name: paywall
contracts.description: Paid access control for gated resources and memberships.

contracts.name: polls
contracts.description: Polls and voting.

contracts.name: predictionmarkets
contracts.description: Prediction markets with positions, resolution, and winner claims.

actions.name: resolveMarket
actions.description: Resolve an open market after it closes (creator only). A market whose winning option has no stakes is voided so stakers can reclaim them.

actions.name: claimWinnings
actions.description: Request your share of the pool for a resolved market, or your stakes back for a voided one.

actions.name: executeProposal
actions.description: Execute an approved proposal once its timelock has expired: by a queue approver, or by a scheduled time action (no sender needed).

contracts.description: Affiliate programs with codes, funded budgets, and payout balances.

contracts.description: Escrow-backed rental agreements for items, passes, or assets.

contracts.description: Revenue share ledgers and withdrawal requests for collaborators.

options.description: House account that receives bets and pays winners. Defaults to the streamer username.

options.name: tokenSymbol

options.description: Accepted assets (HIVE and/or HBD). Defaults to `[tokenSymbol]`.

options.description: Send a 0.001 notice transfer on losses (default false; results are always recorded as events).

options.name: fairness
options.description:
Provably-fair commit-reveal draws, on by default. Pass options or a
shared FairnessManager to customise, or `false` for the legacy RNG

actions.name: spin
actions.description: Place a provably-fair single-zero roulette bet by transferring to the house account. `betType`/`value`: straight 0-36 (pays 36x), color red/black, parity odd/even, range low/high (2x), dozen or column 1-3 (3x). `seed` (optional client seed) at most 64 characters. Invalid bets are refunded.

actions.name: rotateSeed
actions.description: Reveal the current server seed and commit to a new one (house account only).

contracts.name: rps
contracts.description: Rock-paper-scissors with wagers.

options.name: account
options.description: House account that receives bets and pays winners. Defaults to the streamer username.

options.name: tokenSymbol
options.description: Default accepted asset (HIVE). Winnings are always paid in the asset that was bet.

options.name: validCurrencies
options.description: Accepted assets (HIVE and/or HBD). Defaults to `[tokenSymbol]`.

options.name: houseEdge
options.description: House edge in percent (default 2). A win pays the stake x 2 x (100 - houseEdge) / 100, rounded down; ties are refunded.

options.name: notifyLosses
options.description: Send a 0.001 notice transfer on losses (default false; results are always recorded as events).

options.name: fairness
options.description:
Provably-fair commit-reveal draws, on by default. Pass options or a
shared FairnessManager to customise, or `false` for the legacy RNG
(block ids plus an uncommitted server seed; not verifiable).

actions.name: play
actions.description: Play provably-fair rock-paper-scissors against the house by transferring a wager. `move` must be "rock", "paper" or "scissors" and `seed` (optional client seed) at most 64 characters; anything else is refunded. Wins pay 2x the stake less the house edge (2% by default); ties are refunded.

actions.name: rotateSeed
actions.description: Reveal the current server seed and commit to a new one (house account only).

contracts.name: savings
contracts.description: Savings goals with recurring contributions and withdrawal requests.

contracts.name: stakingpool
contracts.description: Staking pools with reward-per-share accrual (per second or per block), funded reward reserves, cooldowns and claims.

options.name: account
options.description: Custody account that receives stakes and reward funding and pays them out. Defaults to the streamer username.

options.name: admins
options.description: Accounts allowed to create pools and change reward rates. Defaults to the custody account.

options.name: accrual
options.description:
'time' accrues `rewardRate` per second of block time; 'block' accrues
per block. Either way accrual stops at the pool's `endsAt`.

actions.name: createPool
actions.description: Admin-only: create a pool with stake/reward assets, a reward rate per second (or block), cooldown and optional end time.

actions.name: fundRewards
actions.description: Top up a pool's reward reserve. Rewards never accrue beyond what has been funded.

actions.name: stake
actions.description: Stake by transferring the pool's stake asset; wrong assets, tiny amounts and ended pools are refunded.

actions.name: unstake
actions.description: Start unbonding part of your stake; funds are released after the pool's cooldown.

actions.name: withdraw
actions.description: Release your matured unbonding entries, including any whose earlier transfer failed.

actions.name: claim
actions.description: Pay out accrued rewards (rounded down to the asset precision; the remainder stays pending). Re-sends earlier claims whose transfer failed.

actions.name: setRewardRate
actions.description: Admin-only: change the reward rate after settling accruals at the old rate.

actions.name: releaseMatured
actions.description: Scheduled release of every matured unbonding entry, retrying failed transfers.

contracts.name: subscriptions
contracts.description: Subscription plans renewed by transfers or recurrent transfers.

contracts.name: sweepstakes
contracts.description: Paid-entry sweepstakes with deterministic winner draws.

contracts.name: ticketing
contracts.description: Event ticketing with purchases, check-ins, refunds, transfers, and resale.

contracts.name: tipjar
contracts.description: A tip jar with an optional message board.

contracts.name: tournaments
contracts.description: Game tournaments with entry fees, registration windows, oracle-submitted scores, tie handling and basis-point prize splits.

options.name: account
options.description: Account that receives entry fees and pays prizes. Entries sent elsewhere are rejected. Defaults to the streamer username.

options.name: feeBps
options.description: House fee taken from the prize pool, in basis points (max 3000).

options.name: feeAccount
options.description: Where the house fee is sent. Defaults to keeping it in `account`.

options.name: oracles
options.description: Accounts allowed to submit scores for any tournament, in addition to each tournament's oracle.

options.name: organizers
options.description:
When set, only these accounts can create tournaments, and a
tournament's oracle defaults to its (trusted) organizer.

When unset, anyone can create a tournament. An organizer who could
also score it could enter an alt account, score it first and take the
whole pot, so open tournaments are scored by the app account (or one of
`oracles`) only: the oracle defaults to the app account and a
tournament's `oracle` must be the app account or one of `oracles`.

actions.name: createTournament
actions.description: Create a tournament with an entry fee, registration window, player limits and a basis-point prize split.

actions.name: enter
actions.description: Enter by transferring the exact entry fee; wrong assets, amounts, duplicates and closed registrations are refunded.

actions.name: submitScore
actions.description: Oracle-only: record a player score after registration closes.

actions.name: submitScores
actions.description: Oracle-only: record up to 100 scores in one operation.

actions.name: finalize
actions.description: Rank players, take the house fee and pay prizes; under-subscribed tournaments are cancelled and refunded.

actions.name: finalizeDue
actions.description: Scheduled sweep that finalizes tournaments past their end time.

actions.name: cancelTournament
actions.description: Organizer-only: cancel and refund every entry.

actions.name: retryPayouts
actions.description: App account or organizer: re-send prizes or refunds whose transfer failed.
